Welcome to the official website of Mara Group
Discover our hotels in Cantabria and Asturias
The Mara Group welcome you to our official website, hoping that you find all the information you need about our hotels in Cantabria and Asturias.
We understand that you wouldn’t trust your vacation to just anyone, and that’s why we offer you comfortable accommodations, with excellent facilities and services, and all the guarantees. These are quality hotels, excellently located and close to the most interesting places in San Vicente de la Barquera, Llanes or the center of Santander.
You can stay in a designer hotel or a family apartment , depending on your preferences. We adapt to you and your circumstances so you can enjoy your vacation to the fullest.
Would you like to come and visit us?
Read more
Accommodation in Cantabria
San Vicente de la Barquera - Hotel Faro de San Vicente
There are many reasons to visit Cantabria, a land of breathtaking landscapes for all tastes and colors. And in this paradise, where green undoubtedly stands out you will find San Vicente de la Barquera, known for its remarkable historical heritage, exceptional natural surroundings, and renowned gastronomy.
In San Vicente, next to the fishing port and just five minutes from the city center, you will find Hotel Faro de San Vicente. It offers double and family rooms, equipped with a private bathroom, flat-screen TV, telephone, free wifi , desk, alarm clock, fan, and central heating.
You can also enjoy free wifi throughout the hotel, luggage storage service, ticket sales for shows and other attractions, fax, photocopier, tourist information, and a 24-hour reception. The facilities are outstanding, including a splendid terrace and a glass-enclosed gallery with views of the estuary.
If you want to spend a few days in San Vicente de la Barquera with your partner or family, this is your place to stay. Enjoy it!
Santander City Center - Hotel Sol Boutique
In the heart of Santander and near the city's most iconic landmarks, this hotel occupies the space of two restored 19th-century mansions. Undoubtedly, a charming location for a dream vacation in Santander.
It is a small and exclusive hotel with only 19 double rooms, each one different, carefully decorated to create unique, warm, and cozy spaces. You can choose from different types of rooms, including our Classic rooms, with a balcony, gallery, or terrace; the Premium round bed rooms; or the exceptional Duplex Junior Suite , which includes an additional living area on the upper floor.
Additionally, we offer a wide range of services and fantastic facilities so you can enjoy a luxurious stay. Relax in our landscaped terrace, a true oasis to escape the daily routine.
Accommodation in Asturias
Llanes , Asturias - Hotel Puerto de Llanes
Located in the heart of Llanes , in one of the town’s quietest areas, you will find Hotel Puerto de Llanes , housed in a protected building due to its significant cultural and historical value.
The hotel offers double rooms and fully equipped studio apartments, modern and cozy, perfect for exploring the historic center, fantastic beaches, and renowned restaurants. Ideal for couples and families!
It features free wifi, a 24-hour reception service, tourist information, wake-up service, heating, and parking upon request. For relaxation and comfort, we also offer a small garden in the city center.
Book now on our official website and get the best online rates
At Mara Group , our main goal is to offer you an exceptional stay so that you enjoy every moment and always want to return.

All our hotels are fully equipped with everything you need and have been carefully and lovingly decorated. We specialize in creating intimate, comfortable, and welcoming spaces.

Hotels in Cantabria
Hotel in San Vicente de la Barquera - Hotel Faro de San Vicente
If you're looking for a hotel in Cantabria with an excellent location, this is the one for you. It is situated next to the fishing port and just a few minutes from the historic center, as well as the shopping and dining areas. All rooms, whether double or family, are equipped with a double bed or two single beds; a private bathroom with a bathtub, hairdryer, and amenities; a flat-screen TV, telephone, free WiFi, desk, alarm clock, fan, and central heating. Some rooms also offer magnificent views of the estuary. Like all Mara Group accommodations, Hotel Faro de San Vicente features fantastic facilities and a wide range of services. You can enjoy a 24-hour reception, free WiFi throughout the hotel, luggage storage service, ticket sales, fax, photocopier, and tourist information. Due to its location and amenities, it is the ideal hotel for a romantic getaway or a family vacation. Don't forget to enjoy the views from the terrace or the glass-enclosed gallery.
Hotel in Santander City Center - Hotel Sol Boutique
You will find this hotel on Calle del Sol, in the city center of Santander. It boasts an exceptional location for exploring the lively pedestrian streets of the center, filled with shops, businesses, and restaurants. Hotel Sol Boutique is an exclusive hotel, distinguished by its elegant decor, where each room is unique. We offer various types of rooms: Classic (with a balcony, gallery, or terrace), Premium with a round bed, and an exclusive Duplex Junior Suite with extra space and an additional living area on the upper floor. All rooms are equipped with everything you need for a perfect vacation. However, what will truly make you feel at home is our warm and personalized service. Feel free to ask us for anything you need, and we will assist you with a smile.
Hotels in Asturias
Hotel in Llanes - Hotel Puerto de Llanes
If you're looking for a hotel for a romantic getaway in Llanes… this is the one for you! If you're looking for an apartment for a family vacation… this is also the one! Hotel Puerto de Llanes is perfect for couples, families, or groups of friends who want to explore the main attractions of the area. You can stay in spacious and cozy rooms or in modern, bright studio apartments. The rooms, featuring large windows, include two single beds or a double bed, a full bathroom, a flat-screen TV, free WiFi, and heating. The studio apartments also have an additional sofa bed and are equipped with everything you might need during your stay with us.

Hotel in Santander, very close to the city center and the restaurant district
Welcome to the official website of Hotel Sol Boutique
Can you imagine enjoying a special, unique accommodation? Hotel Sol Boutique is a charming 4-star hotel with exclusive design, located in the heart of Santander, offering all the services you need at your fingertips.
Just a few meters from the Church of the Carmelites, it occupies the space of two restored 19th-century mansions, Villa Carmina and Villa Rosa María. These buildings, now converted into a hotel, are part of the city's protected heritage. One could say it is like a hidden gem that holds true works of art inside.
This is a cozy hotel characterized by meticulous decoration, where attention to detail makes all the difference. Each room is unique, giving you the feeling of walking through a fantastic art gallery. That is why spending a night with us can be an absolutely sensory and enriching experience.
We will surprise you with a warm and personal service, making you feel like part of a big family. We will do everything we can to ensure your stay here is perfect. And we guarantee that you won’t want to leave.
Read more
Designer Rooms in the Heart of Santander
Hotel Sol Boutique offers 19 double rooms, carefully and lovingly decorated to create warm and welcoming spaces where you will feel wonderful. There are different types of rooms: Classic, with a balcony, gallery, or terrace; Premium with a round bed; or the Duplex Junior Suite, which includes an additional living area on the upper floor. However, they all share a common feature: a unique design, like small works of art waiting to be admired. The rooms are equipped with air conditioning and climate control, smart automation, Smart TV with international channels, telephone, free WiFi, a full bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and complimentary toiletries. Additionally, they include a safe, coffee/tea maker, and a mini-fridge.
Fantastic Services and a Warm, Family-Like Atmosphere
This hotel in the center of Santander is unlike any other. Here, everything becomes a personal experience, making it the perfect place to create unforgettable memories. We offer personalized service during your stay to make you feel at home. Our services include a 24-hour reception, tourist information, luggage storage, free WiFi throughout the hotel, wake-up service, heating, parking upon request, and even a pillow menu to ensure a restful sleep. Additionally, we have a fantastic garden terrace, an oasis in the heart of the city where you can relax and unwind.
Santander, a Beautiful City to Discover
Located near the center of Santander and close to the city’s most iconic landmarks and dining areas, Hotel Sol Boutique boasts an excellent location. Some must-visit places during your stay include the Botín Center, Santander Cathedral, the Puertochico neighborhood, the Festival Palace, the Maritime Museum, the Prehistory Museum, or the Paseo de Pereda, among others. Open the door. Step inside. Welcome to a different world, where art and beauty take center stage.
Classic Double
A comfortable and charming room, perfect for resting after exploring Santander. Each Classic Double has a unique design and all the details to make you feel at home: full bathroom, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, coffee maker, mini fridge, and safe. Ideal for city getaways as a couple or for business trips.
Book
Double with Terrace
The most exclusive in this category: enjoy your own outdoor space with a large terrace equipped with table and chairs. Perfect for relaxing in the sun or toasting at sunset. In addition to all the amenities (Wi-Fi, coffee maker, minibar, air conditioning…), you'll enjoy a unique experience in Santander.
Book
Double with Balcony
Your retreat with an extra touch: access to a private balcony where you can breathe fresh air and take in the views. Exclusive décor, a comfortable bed, full bathroom, air conditioning, and modern services designed for your comfort. Ideal for those who want a hint of the outdoors without giving up comfort.
Book
Double with Gallery
Natural light and charm in a glass-enclosed gallery that turns your room into a bright and cozy space. Perfect for relaxing with a book or enjoying a coffee with sheltered views. All with the usual comforts: free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, coffee maker, and minibar.
Book
Premium
Unique, elegant rooms with a detail that makes them unforgettable: a round bed that elevates your experience. Modern, comfortable spaces with every convenience (Wi-Fi, air conditioning, safe, coffee maker, minibar). Designed for couples looking for something special.
Book
Junior Duplex Suite
The jewel of the hotel, located in one of the building's turrets. A spacious duplex-style room: on the lower level, a round bed and lounge area; on the upper level, two single beds to complete the experience. Perfect for romantic getaways or family stays looking for something different and memorable.

Hotel Faro de San Vicente
Hotel in San Vicente de la Barquera
If you are someone who dreams awake and envisions a vacation by the sea, you have come to the right place. Welcome to the official website of Hotel Faro de San Vicente.
Would you like to step inside?
Read more
Located next to the fishing port and just five minutes from the center and historic district of San Vicente, this hotel offers an exceptional panoramic view of the old town and the entire bay.
We offer fully equipped rooms with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The hotel also features spaces designed for meetings and events. From the terrace, you can enjoy breathtaking views—the perfect setting to relax and breathe in the fresh air.
Fully Equipped Double or Single Rooms
All our rooms, whether with a double bed or two single beds, are spacious and cozy. They feature wooden floors and are equipped with a private bathroom with a bathtub (including a hairdryer and toiletries), a flat-screen TV, telephone, free WiFi, desk, alarm clock, fan, and central heating. Some rooms also offer stunning views of the estuary, where the Escudo and Gandarilla rivers flow into the Cantabrian Sea.
All the Services and Amenities for Your Stay
Hotel Faro de San Vicente boasts fantastic facilities and a wide range of services. It offers free WiFi in all common areas, luggage storage, ticket sales for shows and points of interest, fax, photocopier, tourist information, and 24-hour reception. It is an excellent choice for families, featuring family rooms and various entertainment options such as puzzles and board games. If you’d like to surprise your partner with a romantic gesture, request chocolates or a bottle of wine—it’s sure to impress! Additionally, the hotel includes a terrace overlooking the estuary, various rooms for hosting meetings and banquets, and a glass-enclosed gallery with spectacular views. Our accommodation is perfect for exploring the Picos de Europa National Park or wandering the charming streets of the historic town center. The marshlands of Rubín, Pombo, and San Vicente itself are also must-visit spots.
Book Your Hotel in San Vicente de la Barquera at the Best Online Price
The location of Hotel Faro de San Vicente, next to the fishing port and just minutes from the town’s historic center, is unbeatable. From here, you’ll have easy access to some of the most emblematic buildings in the area, such as the Castillo del Rey, the Torre del Preboste, the Church of Santa María de los Ángeles, and the Chapel of the Virgen de la Barquera, among others.
